memory:
COMPANY: DS Group (Dharampal Satyapal Group), India
SELLS: FMCG. Confectionery (Pulse and Chingles are candy, LuvIt is chocolate), mouth fresheners (Pass Pass, Rajnigandha Silver Pearls), spices (Catch), plus other F&B.
WHO ACTUALLY PAYS (the buyers): the TRADE, not consumers.
  1. Quick commerce: Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, BigBasket (bbnow), Amazon Now
  2. Modern trade: DMart, Reliance Smart/Retail, Star Bazaar, Spencer's, More
  3. Distributors / stockists in towns where DS Group is under-penetrated
  4. HoReCa & travel: hotels, restaurants (after-meal mouth freshener), airports, cinemas
  5. Institutional: CSD canteens, IRCTC, corporate canteens (via tenders, e.g. GeM)
PRIORITIES (use for Fit scoring):
  - Grow confectionery toward Rs 5,000 cr (from ~Rs 1,000 cr, FY24)
  - Expand in SOUTH and WEST India (already strong in North and East)
  - Quick commerce and e-commerce push for Pulse, Pass Pass, Silver Pearls, LuvIt
  - New formats and line extensions; exports (recently entered Nepal)
NOT BUYERS: consumers, regulators, schools banning snacks, US/EU retailers, competitors (Parle, Mondelez, Perfetti, ITC, Nestle).
IMPORTANT: existing retail partners EXPANDING (new city, new stores, new format) ARE valid leads in FMCG. This is an upsell / new-listing signal.
COMPLIANCE: no health claims, no FSSAI-unsafe wording, no celebrity or third-party brand use without permission, no invented partnerships or numbers.
